classification.difficultyReason: Part b requires constructing an unsupplied decomposition of the stepped outline into two squares and a triangle, then combining marked lengths to obtain both triangle dimensions. Other parts require interpreting shared bases, complementary lengths and frame widths.

content.prompt: Calculate the area of these shapes.

spec.description: Parallelogram surrounding an unshaded triangle, with both remaining triangular regions shaded.
spec.mathematics: The parallelogram and central triangle share a 6 m base and 3 m perpendicular height. Opposite outer sides are marked parallel.
spec.answerVisibility: Measurements and measured-region shading are permanent givens; the area answer is hidden.

answer.worked:
Subtract the central triangle from the parallelogram.
$$\begin{align*}A_1&=6\times3\\A_1&=18\,\mathrm{m}^2\\A_2&=\frac{6\times3}{2}\\A_2&=9\,\mathrm{m}^2\\A_{\text{shaded}}&=18-9\\A_{\text{shaded}}&=9\,\mathrm{m}^2\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Stepped polygon with eight equal horizontal or vertical boundary segments and an unmarked diagonal boundary.
spec.mathematics: Each marked segment is 2 m. The figure decomposes into two 2 m squares and a right triangle with base and height 4 m.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the 2 m given and equality marks are visible.

answer.worked:
Split the figure into two squares and a right triangle. Each marked side is $2\,\mathrm{m}$.
$$\begin{align*}b_{\text{triangle}}&=2+2=4\,\mathrm{m}\\h_{\text{triangle}}&=2+2=4\,\mathrm{m}\\A_{\text{squares}}&=2\times(2\times2)\\A_{\text{squares}}&=8\,\mathrm{m}^2\\A_{\text{triangle}}&=\frac{4\times4}{2}\\A_{\text{triangle}}&=8\,\mathrm{m}^2\\A_{\text{Total}}&=8+8=16\,\mathrm{m}^2\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Upright plus-shaped polygon with twelve equal boundary segments and a full-width dimension arrow.
spec.mathematics: The full width is 12 cm, spanning three equal segments. The figure consists of five congruent squares.
spec.answerVisibility: The 12 cm width and all twelve equality ticks are permanent givens.

answer.worked:
Split the cross into five equal squares.
$$\begin{align*}s&=12\div3\\s&=4\,\mathrm{cm}\\A_{\text{square}}&=4\times4\\A_{\text{square}}&=16\,\mathrm{cm}^2\\A_{\text{Total}}&=5\times16\\A_{\text{Total}}&=80\,\mathrm{cm}^2\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Parallelogram joined to a tilted square along a dashed shared edge, retaining parallel marks, equality ticks and right-angle markers.
spec.mathematics: The parallelogram has base 4 cm and perpendicular height 2 cm. The adjoining square has side 3 cm. The drawing retains the source's schematic proportions.
spec.answerVisibility: All dimensions and structural marks are visible; calculated areas are hidden.

answer.worked:
Add the areas of the parallelogram and square.
$$\begin{align*}A_1&=4\times2\\A_1&=8\,\mathrm{cm}^2\\A_2&=3\times3\\A_2&=9\,\mathrm{cm}^2\\A_{\text{Total}}&=8+9\\A_{\text{Total}}&=17\,\mathrm{cm}^2\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Quadrilateral divided horizontally into upper and lower triangles, with horizontal and vertical span arrows.
spec.mathematics: Shared horizontal base 4 m; total vertical span 3.5 m; upper triangle height 2 m.
spec.answerVisibility: All three dimensions and the dashed dividing segment are visible.

answer.worked:
Add the areas of the two triangles.
$$\begin{align*}h_{\text{lower}}&=3.5-2\\h_{\text{lower}}&=1.5\,\mathrm{m}\\A_1&=\frac{4\times2}{2}\\A_1&=4\,\mathrm{m}^2\\A_2&=\frac{4\times1.5}{2}\\A_2&=3\,\mathrm{m}^2\\A_{\text{Total}}&=4+3=7\,\mathrm{m}^2\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Five-sided polygon with equal top and right edges, equal bottom and inner vertical edges, and a diagonal upper-left boundary.
spec.mathematics: Top and right edges are each 5 m. Bottom and inner vertical edges are each 2 m.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the 5 m and 2 m givens and equality ticks are visible.

answer.worked:
Split vertically through the inner corner to form a rectangle and a triangle.
$$\begin{align*}b_{\text{triangle}}&=5-2=3\,\mathrm{m}\\h_{\text{triangle}}&=5-2=3\,\mathrm{m}\\A_1&=2\times5\\A_1&=10\,\mathrm{m}^2\\A_2&=\frac{3\times3}{2}\\A_2&=4.5\,\mathrm{m}^2\\A_{\text{Total}}&=10+4.5=14.5\,\mathrm{m}^2\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Tilted upper parallelogram and lower triangle sharing a dashed base, with separate perpendicular heights.
spec.mathematics: The shared base equals the parallel upper edge, 18 cm. Both component perpendicular heights are 7 cm. The lowest vertex lies on the extension of the upper-left side.
spec.answerVisibility: The 18 cm base, both 7 cm heights and all structural marks are visible.

answer.worked:
The shared base is $18\,\mathrm{cm}$ because opposite sides of the parallelogram are equal. Add the parallelogram and triangle areas.
$$\begin{align*}A_1&=18\times7\\A_1&=126\,\mathrm{cm}^2\\A_2&=\frac{18\times7}{2}\\A_2&=63\,\mathrm{cm}^2\\A_{\text{Total}}&=126+63\\A_{\text{Total}}&=189\,\mathrm{cm}^2\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Right trapezium with upper and lower dimension arrows, an internal height arrow, and a dashed perpendicular dividing line.
spec.mathematics: Parallel horizontal sides measure 8 cm and 15 cm. Perpendicular height is 10 cm. Three right-angle markers identify the perpendicular relationships.
spec.answerVisibility: All dimensions and supplied decomposition guides are visible.

answer.worked:
Use the dashed line to split the figure into a rectangle and a triangle.
$$\begin{align*}b_{\text{triangle}}&=15-8\\b_{\text{triangle}}&=7\,\mathrm{cm}\\A_1&=8\times10\\A_1&=80\,\mathrm{cm}^2\\A_2&=\frac{7\times10}{2}\\A_2&=35\,\mathrm{cm}^2\\A_{\text{Total}}&=80+35=115\,\mathrm{cm}^2\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Shaded rectangular frame with an unshaded inner rectangle and four separately labelled border-width arrows.
spec.mathematics: Outer rectangle is 14 m by 20 m; the frame is 3 m wide on every side.
spec.answerVisibility: All six source measurements and the measured-region shading remain visible.

answer.worked:
Subtract the inner rectangle from the outer rectangle.
$$\begin{align*}w_{\text{inner}}&=14-3-3=8\,\mathrm{m}\\h_{\text{inner}}&=20-3-3=14\,\mathrm{m}\\A_1&=14\times20\\A_1&=280\,\mathrm{m}^2\\A_2&=8\times14\\A_2&=112\,\mathrm{m}^2\\A_{\text{shaded}}&=280-112\\A_{\text{shaded}}&=168\,\mathrm{m}^2\end{align*}$$
